natural: Heralds in front and a crowd behind

meaning.en: Surrounded by a large entourage.
meaning.zh: 前面有人吆喝开路，后面有人簇拥保护。形容达官贵人出行时随从很多。

examples.zh: 明星在保镖的前呼后拥下走进会场。
examples.en: The star entered the venue surrounded by bodyguards.

examples.zh: 他当官时前呼后拥，退休后门可罗雀。
examples.en: In office he had a huge entourage; retired, no one visits.

natural: Gold and jade filling the hall

meaning.en: Great wealth; a house full of treasures (a blessing). Also: full of learning.
meaning.zh: 金玉财宝满堂。形容财富极多，也形容学识丰富。常用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 祝您新年金玉满堂，富贵吉祥！
examples.en: Wishing you a New Year of wealth and good fortune!

examples.zh: 金玉满堂，莫之能守。
examples.en: A hall full of gold and jade cannot be guarded forever.

story.en: Laozi warned: "Gold and jade fill the hall, yet none can guard them" (金玉满堂，莫之能守) — wealth invites loss.
story.zh: 《老子》："金玉满堂，莫之能守；富贵而骄，自遗其咎。"

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

natural: As long as heaven, as lasting as earth

meaning.en: Everlasting (especially of love or friendship).
meaning.zh: 跟天和地存在的时间一样长。形容时间悠久，多指爱情永恒不变。

examples.zh: 祝你们的爱情天长地久。
examples.en: May your love last forever.

examples.zh: 我们的友谊地久天长。
examples.en: Our friendship will last forever.

story.en: Laozi: "Heaven is long-lasting and earth endures. They endure because they do not live for themselves." Bai Juyi's Song of Everlasting Sorrow later used it for love.
story.zh: 《老子》："天长地久。天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。"白居易《长恨歌》："天长地久有时尽。"

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate. Also 地久天长 (title of the Chinese "Auld Lang Syne").
usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"地久天长"。

pinyin: jì lái zhī zé ān zhī
literal: since · come · them · then · settle · them
natural: Since you've come, settle in

meaning.en: Since you're here, make the best of it.
meaning.zh: 原指招抚远方的人归附，并使之安心。后指既然来了，就安下心来。

examples.zh: 既来之则安之，好好适应新环境吧。
examples.en: Since you're here, make the best of it and settle in.

examples.zh: 飞机延误了，既来之则安之，在机场看看书。
examples.en: The flight's delayed — might as well make the best of it and read.

story.en: Confucius: "If distant people do not submit, cultivate virtue to attract them; once they have come, make them settled" (既来之，则安之).
story.zh: 《论语·季氏》："故远人不服，则修文德以来之；既来之，则安之。"

natural: The Jingwei bird filling the sea

meaning.en: Dogged determination against impossible odds.
meaning.zh: 比喻意志坚决，不畏艰难。

examples.zh: 他以精卫填海的精神坚持了二十年。
examples.en: With indomitable will, he persevered for twenty years.

examples.zh: 精卫填海的故事告诉我们要坚持不懈。
examples.en: The Jingwei story teaches us never to give up.

story.en: Emperor Yan's daughter drowned in the Eastern Sea and became the Jingwei bird. She carried twigs and pebbles from the Western Hills every day to fill the sea.
story.zh: 炎帝的女儿在东海溺死，化为精卫鸟，常衔西山的木石填东海。

date.zh: 战国至汉 · 前4世纪—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Han, 4th–1st c. BC

natural: Ears and temples rubbing together

meaning.en: Very close and intimate since childhood.
meaning.zh: 耳与鬓发相摩擦。形容亲密相处，多指青梅竹马。

examples.zh: 他们从小耳鬓厮磨，感情深厚。
examples.en: They grew up side by side and are deeply attached.

examples.zh: 宝玉和黛玉耳鬓厮磨，情投意合。
examples.en: Baoyu and Daiyu were inseparable and kindred spirits.

natural: As precarious as stacked eggs

meaning.en: Extremely precarious.
meaning.zh: 危险得像垒起来的蛋。比喻形势非常危险。

examples.zh: 当时形势危如累卵。
examples.en: The situation at the time was hanging by a thread.

examples.zh: 公司财务危如累卵。
examples.en: The company's finances are a house of cards.

story.en: Fan Ju warned the King of Qin that his state was "more dangerous than stacked eggs" (秦王之国危于累卵).
story.zh: 范雎说："秦王之国危于累卵。"

natural: Carrying thorns to ask for punishment

meaning.en: To offer a humble, sincere apology.
meaning.zh: 背着荆条向对方请罪。表示向人认错赔罪。

examples.zh: 他意识到错误后，负荆请罪。
examples.en: Realising his mistake, he went to apologise humbly.

examples.zh: 我今天是来负荆请罪的。
examples.en: I've come today to apologise properly.

story.en: General Lian Po resented the minister Lin Xiangru's promotion, but Lin avoided conflict for the state's sake. Ashamed, Lian Po stripped to the waist, carried thorny branches on his back and went to beg forgiveness.
story.zh: 廉颇不满蔺相如位居其上，蔺相如以国事为重处处退让。廉颇得知后惭愧，袒露上身背着荆条到蔺相如家请罪。

natural: Besieging Wei to rescue Zhao

meaning.en: To relieve an ally by attacking the enemy's base.
meaning.zh: 比喻袭击敌人后方的据点以迫使进攻之敌撤退的战术。

examples.zh: 这一招围魏救赵，迫使对手撤回防守。
examples.en: The indirect attack forced the opponent to pull back.

examples.zh: 我们用围魏救赵的办法解决了这个问题。
examples.en: We solved the problem with an indirect approach.

story.en: When Wei besieged Zhao's capital, the Qi strategist Sun Bin attacked Wei's own capital instead. Wei's army rushed home and was ambushed at Guiling.
story.zh: 魏国围攻赵国都城邯郸，齐国孙膑率军直攻魏都大梁，魏军回救，在桂陵被齐军伏击大败。

usage.en: Subject or object. One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语。为三十六计之一。

natural: Losing soldiers and generals

meaning.en: To suffer heavy losses.
meaning.zh: 兵士和将领都有损失。指作战失利。

examples.zh: 敌军这次损兵折将，大败而归。
examples.en: The enemy suffered heavy losses and retreated in defeat.

examples.zh: 球队主力受伤，损兵折将。
examples.en: With key players injured, the team has taken a beating.

usage.en: Predicate. 折 is zhé; 将 is jiàng.

natural: Like a rat poking its head out both ways

meaning.en: To waver; sit on the fence.
meaning.zh: 在洞口探头探脑、进退不定的老鼠。比喻迟疑不决或动摇不定。

examples.zh: 在这个问题上，他首鼠两端，不肯表态。
examples.en: He sat on the fence and wouldn't take a stand.

examples.zh: 关键时刻不能首鼠两端。
examples.en: At a critical moment you can't waver.

story.en: The chancellor Tian Fen rebuked an official who wouldn't take sides: "Why are you like a rat with its head poking both ways?" (何为首鼠两端).
story.zh: 田蚡责问韩安国："何为首鼠两端？"

synonyms: 一脚踏两只船——左右为难

natural: A mantis raising its arm to stop a cart

meaning.en: A hopeless attempt to resist an overwhelming force.
meaning.zh: 螳螂举起前腿想挡住车子前进。比喻做力量做不到的事情，必然失败。

equivalents: like King Canute holding back the tide

examples.zh: 想阻止技术进步，无异于螳臂当车。
examples.en: Trying to stop technological progress is like holding back the tide.

examples.zh: 他们螳臂当车，结果一败涂地。
examples.en: Their hopeless resistance ended in total defeat.

story.en: Zhuangzi: "Don't you know the praying mantis? It angrily raises its arms to block a chariot wheel, not knowing it can't succeed."
story.zh: 《庄子·人间世》："汝不知夫螳螂乎？怒其臂以当车辙，不知其不胜任也。"

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

antonyms: 世界潮流，浩浩荡荡，顺之者昌，逆之者亡

natural: Rising at cockcrow to practise swordplay

meaning.en: Rising early to train diligently.
meaning.zh: 听到鸡叫就起来舞剑。比喻有志报国的人及时奋起。

equivalents: up at the crack of dawn

examples.zh: 他闻鸡起舞，每天清晨练功。
examples.en: He's up at the crack of dawn every day to train.

examples.zh: 学习要有闻鸡起舞的精神。
examples.en: Learn with the dedication of rising at dawn to practise.

story.en: Zu Ti and his friend Liu Kun, determined to serve their country, would get up at the sound of the cock at midnight to practise swordplay.
story.zh: 祖逖与刘琨同寝，半夜听到鸡叫，就起来舞剑练武。

natural: Personally being in the place

meaning.en: To be there in person; as if one were there.
meaning.zh: 亲自到了那个地方。

examples.zh: 只有亲临其境，才能感受长城的雄伟。
examples.en: Only by being there in person can you feel the Great Wall's grandeur.

examples.zh: 这部纪录片让观众有亲临其境的感觉。
examples.en: The documentary makes viewers feel as if they were there.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Close to 身临其境.

natural: When the tree falls, the monkeys scatter

meaning.en: When the leader falls, the followers scatter.
meaning.zh: 树倒了，树上的猴子就散去。比喻为首的人垮台，依附的人也随之散伙。

examples.zh: 老板被抓后，公司树倒猢狲散。
examples.en: When the boss was arrested, everyone deserted the company like rats from a sinking ship.

examples.zh: 他失势后，身边的人树倒猢狲散。
examples.en: After his fall, his hangers-on scattered.

story.en: Cao Yong rose by attaching himself to the powerful chancellor Qin Hui. When Qin died, a man Cao had snubbed sent him a poem titled "When the tree falls, the monkeys scatter".
story.zh: 曹咏依附秦桧得官，秦桧死后，曾被曹咏冷落的厉德斯寄给他一篇《树倒猢狲散赋》。

usage.zh: 多作谓语或单独成句，贬义。

synonyms: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞

natural: Raising the tray to eyebrow level

meaning.en: (Of a couple) mutual respect and devotion.
meaning.zh: 送饭时把托盘举得与眉毛一样高。形容夫妻相互尊敬。

examples.zh: 这对老夫妻举案齐眉，恩爱一生。
examples.en: The old couple treated each other with devoted respect all their lives.

examples.zh: 祝新人举案齐眉，白头偕老。
examples.en: May the newlyweds respect each other and grow old together.

story.en: The scholar Liang Hong's wife Meng Guang always served his meals with the tray raised to her eyebrows, showing respect; he treated her equally.
story.zh: 梁鸿的妻子孟光每次给他送饭，都把托盘举到和眉毛一样高，表示尊敬。

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 相敬如宾.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"相敬如宾"连用。

natural: The mantis stalking the cicada

meaning.en: Focusing on prey while unaware of danger behind.
meaning.zh: 螳螂捉蝉，不知黄雀在它后面正要吃它。比喻目光短浅，只想到算计别人，没想到别人在算计他。

examples.zh: 螳螂捕蝉，黄雀在后，他算计别人，结果被人算计。
examples.en: The hunter became the hunted — he schemed against others and was schemed against.

examples.zh: 做事要小心，别螳螂捕蝉，黄雀在后。
examples.en: Be careful — while you chase your prey, someone may be stalking you.

story.en: A young man warned the King of Wu against attacking Chu: a cicada sings, unaware of a mantis behind it; the mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of an oriole; the oriole is unaware of the boy with a slingshot below.
story.zh: 少孺子以"蝉在高处饮露，不知螳螂在其后；螳螂欲取蝉，不知黄雀在其旁；黄雀欲啄螳螂，不知弹丸在其下"劝谏吴王。

natural: Dropping helmets and abandoning armour

meaning.en: To flee in utter defeat.
meaning.zh: 丢掉头盔，抛弃铠甲。形容吃了败仗狼狈逃跑。

examples.zh: 敌军丢盔弃甲，狼狈逃窜。
examples.en: The enemy fled in disarray.

examples.zh: 客队被打得丢盔弃甲。
examples.en: The visiting team was routed.

natural: Leaving the dark for the light

meaning.en: To leave the wrong side and join the right one.
meaning.zh: 离开黑暗，投向光明。比喻在政治上脱离反动阵营，投向进步方面。

examples.zh: 他终于弃暗投明，脱离了犯罪团伙。
examples.en: He finally switched sides and left the gang.

examples.zh: 敌军中有不少人弃暗投明。
examples.en: Many in the enemy ranks defected to the right side.

natural: Buying the box and returning the pearl

meaning.en: To value the packaging over the contents; poor judgement.
meaning.zh: 买下装珍珠的木匣，退还了珍珠。比喻没有眼力，取舍不当。

equivalents: value the wrapping over the gift
judge a book by its cover

examples.zh: 只看包装不看质量，是买椟还珠。
examples.en: Caring about packaging rather than quality is missing the point.

examples.zh: 他买椟还珠，丢了最重要的东西。
examples.en: He chose the trimmings and gave away what really mattered.

story.en: A man of Chu sold a pearl in a box of fragrant wood decorated with jewels. A man of Zheng bought the box and gave back the pearl.
story.zh: 楚人卖珍珠，用名贵木料做了华丽的匣子。郑人买下匣子，却把珍珠还给了他。

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

natural: One character worth a thousand gold

meaning.en: (Of writing) every word is priceless; perfectly polished.
meaning.zh: 增删一字，赏给千金。称赞文辞精妙，价值极高。

equivalents: not a word out of place

examples.zh: 这篇文章一字千金，无可挑剔。
examples.en: Every word of this essay is priceless — flawless.

examples.zh: 大师的题词一字千金。
examples.en: The master's inscription is worth its weight in gold.

story.en: Lü Buwei displayed his compendium Lüshi Chunqiu at Xianyang's gate and offered a thousand gold to anyone who could add or remove a single character.
story.zh: 吕不韦把《吕氏春秋》公布在咸阳城门，悬赏能增减一字者赏千金。

usage.en: Predicate. In speech 一 is yí.

natural: Done in a single sweep of the brush

meaning.en: To dash off (a piece of writing or painting) effortlessly.
meaning.zh: 一动笔就写成了。形容写字、写文章、画画很快。

examples.zh: 他提起笔，一挥而就写下了一副对联。
examples.en: He picked up the brush and dashed off a couplet.

examples.zh: 这篇稿子她一挥而就。
examples.en: She wrote the article in one go.

usage.en: Predicate. In speech 一 is yì.

natural: Hiding a beauty in a golden house

meaning.en: To keep a mistress; (originally) to cherish a wife.
meaning.zh: 原指汉武帝要以金屋接纳阿娇为妻。后指纳妾或在外养情人。

examples.zh: 这个富商被曝金屋藏娇。
examples.en: The tycoon was exposed for keeping a mistress.

examples.zh: "金屋藏娇"原本是一个浪漫的故事。
examples.en: "A golden house for Ajiao" was originally a romantic story.

story.en: As a boy, the future Emperor Wu was asked whether he would like to marry his cousin Ajiao. He said: "If I get Ajiao, I'll build a golden house to keep her in."
story.zh: 汉武帝幼时，姑母问他想不想娶阿娇，他说："若得阿娇作妇，当作金屋贮之。"

date.zh: 魏晋南北朝 · 约4—5世纪（托名班固）
date.en: Wei–Jin and Southern and Northern Dynasties, c. 4th–5th c. (attributed to Ban Gu)

usage.zh: 多作谓语，现多指包养情人。

natural: Burning books and burying scholars

meaning.en: Burning books and persecuting intellectuals; extreme censorship.
meaning.zh: 秦始皇焚烧书籍，坑杀儒生。比喻摧残文化，迫害知识分子。

examples.zh: 焚书坑儒是秦朝暴政的标志。
examples.en: The burning of books and burying of scholars symbolised Qin tyranny.

examples.zh: 历史上的焚书坑儒造成了巨大的文化损失。
examples.en: The historical purge of books and scholars caused huge cultural loss.

story.en: In 213 BC the First Emperor ordered the burning of histories and classics except Qin's own; the next year over 460 scholars were reportedly buried alive in Xianyang.
story.zh: 秦始皇三十四年下令焚烧诗书百家语，次年坑杀儒生四百六十余人于咸阳。

natural: Eating without tasting the food

meaning.en: So worried one can't enjoy food.
meaning.zh: 吃东西不觉得味道香甜。形容心里有事，吃东西也不香。

examples.zh: 孩子生病了，妈妈食不甘味。
examples.en: With her child ill, the mother has lost her appetite.

examples.zh: 项目出了问题，他寝不安席，食不甘味。
examples.en: With problems in the project, he can neither sleep nor eat.

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 寝不安席.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"寝不安席"连用。

synonyms: 猪八戒吃人参果——全不知滋味
